title: Subject-banding in Accordance with Students’ Ability and Talent Rather Than Schools’ Requirements
what_it_is: Subject-banding in Accordance with Students’ Ability and Talent Rather Than Schools’ Requirements

sections.label: Post-secondary admission system 2028
sections.summary: Minister outlines plans for 2028 post-secondary admissions, subject banding, aptitude-based admissions, and education and career guidance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education with regard to the post-secondary admission system to be implemented in 2028 (a) how does the new subject banding determine subsequent admission to post-secondary institutions of choice; and (b) how can it be ensured that a student chooses subject bands based on his ability and talent and not influenced primarily by entry criteria of his favoured post-secondary institutions.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: We have some time to work out the details and will announce them in good time.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: But the general thrust is to build upon ongoing efforts to recognise the strengths and talents of students.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For example, we have the Polytechnic Foundation Programme (PFP) today, where students who have done well in the Normal (Academic) course can apply straight to polytechnic.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In future, under "one secondary education, many subject bands", such considerations should not be just for special schemes like PFP, but an integral feature of the posting system.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In a similar vein, we will also study how we can further evolve the Early Admissions Exercise for polytechnics and the Institutes of Technical Education, and Direct School Admissions for junior colleges.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: To help students make informed post-secondary choices, students go through education and career guidance (ECG) in secondary school to help them better understand their strengths and interests.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Full SBB and expanding aptitude-based admissions are part of the multiple pathways that we are creating to better cater to students with different interests and learning needs.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: We will keep evolving our education system to ensure that students are able to choose their subject bands and Post-Secondary Education Institutions based on what best fits their aptitudes and interests.
